# AI PATH Web Studio

Three original mentor teaching demos created on 18 October 2026 for the AI PATH online-school portfolio:

- `flora.webp`: original AI botanical still life used by `examples/flora.html`; the live moodboard is an authored SVG, separate from the generated photograph.
- `mori.webp`: original AI character illustration used by `examples/mori.html`; story choices, chapters, endings and their visual states run in page code.
- `dal.webp`: original AI landscape used by `examples/dal.html`; fictional route selection, authored SVG route diagram and downloadable card run in page code.

Each `*-source.json` records its prompt, generated-source SHA256, delivered-file SHA256 and dimensions. WebP delivery changes encoding and, where recorded, resolution; it does not fabricate a screenshot of a working interface.

The user supplied screenshots of web-design inspiration roundups. These guided the broad use of large imagery, expressive type and meaningful interaction. No third-party component library, paid template, logo or website source was copied.

All three pages visibly identify themselves as AI PATH educational demos with AI imagery and fictional concepts. They are mentor portfolio examples, not student testimonials or commissioned customer work. Generated pictures are not represented as real 3D models, real travel destinations or florist inventory. The demo actions make no purchases, bookings or network submissions.

The public portfolio is `studio.html`. Its illustrations link to the corresponding running demos and the existing beginner Design Lab route. The original real-project galleries and their attribution remain in `index.html`.
